text.tspan: SQSO-HW-DIAG-001 · preliminary · dashed = part not selected (TBD) · TBR = value not confirmed
Sources: hardware/adcs/ADCS_ELECTRICAL_DESIGN.md (LIS3MDL, LSM6DSO, DRV8833), SENSOR_DESIGN.md, ACTUATOR_DESIGN.md; docs/hardware/ADCS_DESIGN.md ADCS-I001/I002; W6
* proposed: no timer pins or nSLEEP/nFAULT pins in the firmware (finding F3).
nFAULT open-drain, 10k pull-up to 3V3_ADCS. AISEN/BISEN grounded: no current
SA1 high: LIS3MDL at 0x1E (ADCS-I001); SA0 low: LSM6DSO at 0x6A.
CS high selects I2C on both. 100 nF at each supply pin (TBR).
Photovoltaic mode (zero bias), Vout = Isc x Rf: 10 uA full sun gives 1 V (TBR).
ADCS-I001 lists 0x40-0x45 for sun sensors, which suggests digital sensors; this analog
chain is a proposal (finding F3). OPA333 single supply, 3V3_ADCS.
